title: 生涯スポーツ演習(クラブ活動)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports

keywords: Lifelong sports 2.Club activities 3.Relationship with social life 4.The fun of sports 5.Problem discovery / solutions
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for Athletic club activities, students will: 1.Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2.Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3.Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through athletic club activities. 1. Applicable club activities Karate, Seiden-Nagao-Ryu-Taijutu, Shorinji kenpo, Kendo, Kyudo, Judo, Volleyball, Badminton, Table tennis, Handball, Basketball, Baseball, Football, Rugby, Tennis, Soft tennis, Skiing, Mountaineering, Track and field, Sailing, Automobile, Golf, Swimming, and Ice hockey 2. To earn class credit, it is students must satisfy all of the following criteria: ・Attend lectures I and II ・Complete all assignments ・15 or more days of activity and at least two-thirds 3. Because it is necessary to participate actively in club activities, close schedule management is necessary. 4. We will check the status of participation club activities using a “ Club Activity Report ” submitted by students every month and a “ Monthly Report on Club Activities ” submitted by the club manager every month.
requiredKnowledge: 1. In addition to club practice days, active participation in competitions and training camps is required. In clubs with only a few practice days, voluntary activities such as self-training are necessary. 2. It is important to continue to participate in club activities throughout the first and second years.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for Athletic club activities and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3)Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5)Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: ・Deepen understanding of how to proceed with classes. ・Attend a lecture on and deepen understanding of safety management.
・Participate in all club activities. ・Understand the current status of learning activities.
lessons.assignments: Homework: ・Submit a portfolio report on life habits. ・Complete a club activity report. ・Write a report.

lessons.content: ・Conduct a lecture. ・Conduct group discussions and share information among clubs. ・Summarize lesson content.
lessons.operation: Conducted in the lecture hall. ・Group discussion and presentation ・Summary of lesson content
